recommendation: Implement comprehensive medication management for asthma patients
implementation_steps: Conduct comprehensive medication reviews to identify drug-related problems
Provide education on proper inhaler technique with demonstration and return demonstration
Monitor medication adherence and identify barriers to adherence
Report concerns to primary care providers to optimize therapy
Lead pharmacist-led interventions to improve asthma control, quality of life, and inhaler technique
evidence_summary: Pharmacist-led medication management interventions have demonstrated significant improvements in asthma control, proper inhaler technique, and medication adherence across multiple systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
citation: Self-Management Interventions to Reduce Healthcare Use and Improve Quality of Life Among Patients With Asthma: Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis. (2020)
